title: Scholar-Hermits in the Autumn Mountains（1976.94）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1976.94）
medium: handscroll, ink and light color on silk
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1500–1510」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: handscroll, ink and light color on silk
Andrew R. and Martha Holden Jennings Fund

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → ming；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: The Cleveland Museum of Art. Handbook of the Cleveland Museum of Art/1978. Cleveland, OH: The Cleveland Museum of Art, 1978.（Reproduced: p. 351）

Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Mentioned and Reproduced: cat. no. 162, p. 198）
Yang, Kathleen 楊凱琳, and Chi-chʻien Wang 王季遷. Through a Chinese connoisseur's eye: private notes of C.C. Wang 王季遷讀書筆記. Beijing: Zhong hua shu ju, 2010.（Mentioned and Reproduced: p. 311, no. 29）

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

colophons.text:
Artist's signature and 2 seals at end of scroll:  Tang Yin 
[seals] T'ang Po-hu; T'ang Tzu'wei t'u-shu.
Title on frontispiece by Li Cho-kung (dates unknown).
1 colophon and 11 additional seals: 1 colophon dated 1915 of Wu Tso-hsi (19th–20th c.); 2 seals of Gao Qifeng 高奇峰 (1889–1933); 5 seals of C. C. Wang 王季遷 (1907–2003); 4 seals unidentified.
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。

provenance.text: (C. C. Wang 王季遷 [1907–2003], New York, NY, sold to the Cleveland Museum of Art)
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH
以上递藏链照录自馆方档案。**本库未独立核实其中任一环节**；经手人身份、交易性质与时间点均以馆方记录为准，本库不据此判定流散性质。
